C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved the message-only rewrite in chat on 2026-10-24, explicitly requested removal of Claude attribution, accepted preservation of file trees, tags and existing releases, and instructed execution.
C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE.Summary: Add a deterministic, fail-closed safety lane for one owner-approved message-only rewrite of main, then use it to remove Claude co-author trailers and the agreed non-product commit wording without changing repository trees or existing release refs.
C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE.Problem: Eleven commits reachable from main contain Claude Co-Authored-By trailers, and selected commit subjects contain service-oriented wording that the owner does not want in the canonical public history. The normal push gate correctly rejects non-fast-forward main updates and needs a narrower proof path before the approved rewrite can occur.

Goals.Goal: Admit exactly one non-fast-forward update of refs/heads/main only when old and new histories are isomorphic by commit count, parent topology, tree, author identity/date and committer identity/date, with commit messages as the only allowed difference.

Scan every changed message through the deterministic static, AI-attribution and Gitleaks boundary, bind the exact ref update and mapping into candidate identity, and write only private hash-bound receipt evidence.

Rewrite the eleven Claude-attributed main commits plus the explicitly approved agent/unreviewed, re-seal and Russian-subject wording in one deterministic pass while preserving every tree byte-for-byte.
Rebase the open feature/documentation pull-request branches onto the rewritten main before they can merge old ancestry back into the canonical line.

Constraints.Constraint: No file tree, author identity/date, committer identity/date, commit count or parent topology may change in the rewrite.
The push may update only refs/heads/main; tags, releases, other remote branches and pull-request refs remain unchanged during this change.
Force-push protection may be bypassed or suspended only for the verified push window and must be restored and read back immediately afterwards.
The exact old/new message map and recovery ref remain owner-local and must never be pushed or committed.
All source, tests, documentation, graph and verification changes land through PR #54 before the operational rewrite.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Removing files, secrets, QA artifacts, GRACE provenance or any other path from historical trees.
Moving, deleting or recreating existing tags or releases, or claiming to erase objects from forks, clones, caches or pull-request refs.
Changing product behavior, release automation, version surfaces or release-train membership in the rewrite-gate change.
Rewriting commit authors, commit dates or messages beyond the owner-approved exact map.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The deterministic gate admits a tested message-only main rewrite and rejects changed trees, identities, dates, topology, count, multiple refs, tags, other branches, stale remote tips and forbidden attribution in any new message.
The rewrite candidate proves every old/new pair before push; all trees and metadata except messages match exactly and the eleven Claude trailers are absent from rewritten main.
The pre-push hook scans and identity-binds the actual non-fast-forward main update; the remote post-push tip equals the reviewed candidate.
Existing tags and releases retain their original object identities, protections are restored, and open PR branches are rebased rather than merged from old ancestry.
M-064, V-M-064, public safety documentation and focused security tests describe and prove the final fail-closed boundary.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/security -p 'test_*.py'; git diff --check; private old/new history isomorphism audit; post-push remote identity and attribution audit
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Green deterministic unit tests, exact candidate receipt, a private complete old/new mapping, unchanged tag identities, zero Claude attribution trailers on rewritten main, restored ruleset state and rebased open pull-request heads.

Assumptions.Assumption: PR #56 is merged and supplies the deterministic v1.9.0 gate baseline.
The later v2.8.2 anchor is separately governed by the existing release-train and release-process contracts after this change is applied.
